I couldn't write any notes on Ezekiel 1. My research tool stopped working before it could open a single page. It returned "no more code_execution tool calls remaining this turn" on the first try and again when I retried. Because I couldn't read anything on the approved sites, I have nothing I can put a URL next to.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written notes from memory. That would mean making up claims about what Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary, the NET notes and others say, without sources.

**Searches I planned next:**
- **Where traditions differ:**
  - The "thirtieth year" (v. 1)
  - Whether the figure on the throne is Christ (vv. 26–28)
  - The four faces and their link to the four Gospels (v. 10)
  - The rainbow and God's covenant (v. 28)
- **Catholic and Orthodox readings:** on newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org, such as the Church Fathers on the four faces and the Gospel writers.
- **Modern scholarship:** on bibleodyssey.org.
- **Popular modern teaching:** any debated claims about the "wheel within a wheel" (v. 16), such as UFO readings, as the approved sites describe them.

If you ask again in a new turn when the tool is available, I'll go through these sources and write the notes verse by verse, with a URL for every point.
